title: Elite Dangerous Odyssey Glare & Exposure Controls — Elite Nexus
description: Tune Odyssey glare, dark tones and exposure in Elite Nexus. Start from Less glare or Morbad’s Odyssey tweak, adjust the ACES curve and the auto-exposure targets, and restore the game’s defaults any time.
heading: Find the light you want to fly in.
lead: Tame bright-light glare and lift dark tones with Odyssey’s own tone-mapping settings. Start with a preset, refine the picture and keep a direct path back to the game’s defaults.
hero_alt: Elite Nexus Glare and exposure tab showing Morbad’s Odyssey tweak, reduced glare and the standard ACES curve.
hero_caption: Morbad’s Odyssey tweak brings reduced glare, different exposure targets and the standard ACES curve into one preset.
